LanguageData.SEC_Alfau_Rabbit.label: Alfau rabbit
LanguageData.SEC_Alfau_Rabbit.description:
Large omnivorous animal originating from the Alfau Peninsula, genetically modified to adapt to alien environment. As a means of saving fossil fuels in agriculture and logistics during the early stages of colonial development, the Alfau rabbits have been following the footsteps of secretaries in exploring the stars, settled down in many worlds and established deep friendship with secretaries for hundreds of years. For some secretaries, their relationship with these big rabbits goes far beyond that of pets. Nowadays, you can see these big cuties in any Alfaus' colony, just don't pull their big tails when you stand behind them, so as not to add medical burden to the colony.
(In theory, nothing should happen if you just hold or gently stroke their big tails.)

Although they are invasive species to the local ecological environment, due to their large size and limited means of self-defense, they often die from hunting by local predators once they leave colony. Therefore, they have not caused significant ecological disasters on any planet so far. However, this does not mean that they can't cause significant damage. In order to effectively replace tractors and light trucks, these rabbits have much stronger muscle strength and toughness than their counterparts, there is almost no difference between being kicked by them and being kicked by horses, and even the impact force far exceeds the latter. Therefore, it is best not to provoke them.

LanguageData.SEC_Wool_Alfau_Rabbit.description: Soft, fragrant, and resilient rabbit hair created by genetic engineering, it's an important material for the Alfaus' textile industry. Although the positioning of Alfau rabbits is closer to that of oxen and horses, secretaries still endowed them with more value through genetic engineering.
LanguageData.SEC_Animal_Alfau_Vorpabbit.label: Alfau vorpabbit
LanguageData.SEC_Animal_Alfau_Vorpabbit.description: Predator originating from the Alfau Peninsula, genetically modified to adapt to alien environment. There are almost no mammals other than lagomorphs on the Alfau Peninsula, various rabbits occupy most of the ecological niche. "Vorpabbits" are similar to canids in other ecosystems, they are the size of large dogs and live in groups in the wilderness, feeding on the flesh and blood of other animals. When there is a shortage of animals in the area, they will start eating local plants. Their wide, razor sharp front teeth can not only carve blood holes in flesh, but also break branches and dig roots. Although they were introduced into the interstellar colonization project as patrol dog, guide dogs, pets, and other roles, there were still many vorpabbits who accidentally left the Alfaus' society during the interstellar colonization process, formed wild herds and caused huge ecological disasters.

LanguageData.SEC_PA_Standard_Light_Power_Armor_Backpa: 按照书姬网络提供的标准模板制造的轻型动力装甲，除外挂装甲板外还拥有一层塑钢基甲，保护范围基本覆盖全身，为书姬们量身定做。该变种挂载了一个标准书姬背包，可以让书姬们携带、搬运更多物品。
LanguageData.SEC_PA_Standard_Power_Armor.description: A fully enclosed standard power armor for secretaries manufactured according to standard template provided by Secretary Nexus, serves as the standard equipment for secretary assaulters. This power armor is equipped with more powerful power backpack, traditional mechanical structures have been replaced by synthetic tendons, ports and slots on both sides allow for external ammunition boxes, medical kits, backpacks, and other additional equipment, a Secretary Nexus terminal is installed in the bottom layer assisting the secretary with targeting, computation, positioning, and command, greatly enhancing the informatization level of secretary assaulters.\n\nSome alien races have claimed that power armor represents a more advanced form of warfare and high‑technology, but secretaries believe its true significance lies in liberating body and mind from monotonous and burdensome tactical actions, allowing people to focus on the battlefield situation and tactical details, thereby uncovering more opportunities for victory. For worlds with more developed industry, power armor also gave poorly trained civilians a chance to defeat professional armies. In the most brutal wars, this very characteristic often becomes the key to ultimate victory.

LanguageData.SEC_Alfau_Militia_Uniform.description:
Standard uniform of the Alfau Militia, very common in the Alfau society. Although referred to as 'militia', the Alfau Militia actually includes almost all mortals in the armed forces of the People's State of Alfau, that is to say, most people except for secretaries. So it can be regarded as the official name of the Alfau's military.

Compared to the entire Alfau society, the number of secretaries is limited, secretaries can't help everyone do every single thing in life, also can't replace all soldiers on the battlefield. So secretaries extract a small portion from the massive Alfaus population, to assist them in doing their duty of protecting the safety of people's lives and property. These militias actively participate in disaster relief and training during peacetime, and in wartime they fill the long front line, defend positions, maintain order, and assist secretary assaulters in attacking.

Nowadays, as Alfaus march towards the stars, the species that guarantee citizenship are becoming increasingly diverse, the Alfau Militia have different style and features on different planets, but their duty has never changed.

LanguageData.SEC_Theory_Book.description: 从书姬数据库中取出的理论小册子，以通俗的文风介绍了苜蓿人民领的官方意识形态，每一册的背面都写有一些生活小常识，家常菜菜谱，古老的领导人语录，以及自嘲式的苜蓿人民领笑话。收藏这些小册子很快成为了苜蓿殖民地的常见爱好。\n\n『我们』提醒您：政治并不是生活的全部，是谋取更美好生活的工具，不要让政治成为生活的主人。每日一思，一天一次，不要让急躁与自卑蒙蔽你的双眼。

LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_Auto_Deep_Drill.descr: 根据书姬网络提供的标准模板制造的轻型自动钻井，不需要人员值班也能正常运行，常见于人口稀少的苜蓿兔人殖民地，用于地质勘探以及满足较小的矿物需求。
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_Food_Synthesizer.desc: A food synthesizer manufactured according to standard template provided by Secretary Nexus. Due to backward productivity, it's difficult to get enough natural food and cook them in a rimworld. So in order to concentrate resources and labor on industrial development, Alfaus designed their own food synthesizer. This machine will process materials into nutrients and synthesize them into edible solids or liquids that look like common meat, vegetables or fruits. These foods are usually presented in the form of single person meals, the specific appearance depends on the user's choice.\n\nSome claiming to be efficient civilizations supply their people with unformed semi-fluid nutrients and think this is the most efficient way to solve food problems. Obviously, they completely ignored the impact of food taste and appearance on labor motivation, they are completely unaware of how many production accidents and costs can be avoided by providing people with more diverse food. Even with just a small increase in food investment, workers can concentrate their attention at work and consciously obey labor discipline.
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_Fabricator.label: Standard Alfau Fabricator
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_Fabricator.descriptio: A multifunctional fabricator manufactured according to standard template provided by Secretary Nexus. To address the shortage of skilled workers in emergent settlements, the Secretary Nexus included this small-sized and full-automatic manufacturing machine that integrates multiple manufacturing processes and has decent machining accuracy in the standard template, it is mainly used for manufacturing small and medium-sized components and personal tools, thus became the starting point of manufacturing in many Alfaus colonies.
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_CarbonCollector.label: Standard Alfau Carbon Collector
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Alfau_CarbonCollector.descr: A carbon collector manufactured according to standard template provided by Secretary Nexus, used to collect carbon contained in air or other input gases.\n\nThe most similar thing between hive cities and interstellar spacecraft is their reliance on artificial material cycle. Like a spacecraft, a hive city is like a solitary boat sailing across ocean, every kilogram of steel, every serving of food, every drop of water, and even every breath of air must be fully utilized in this vast artificial ecosystem, and all waste must be transformed into useful new forms as much as possible, replace the missing natural material cycle with an artificial material cycle. Among them, the recycling of carbon is quite common. The intensive industrial and agricultural production within hive cities not only consumes a large amount of fuels and raw materials containing carbon, but also produces a large amount of consumer goods, building materials, and machinery containing carbon, while spewing out exhaust gas and wastewater containing carbon. The supply and demand of carbon are equally huge. And this carbon collector is the most basic link in the artificial carbon cycle industry chain, used to collect carbon from air and exhaust gases and transform it into a more transportable and processable form.
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Secretary_Nexus_Server.desc: 这座巨大的计算机组是书姬网络节点的核心部分，用于将书姬脑内植入的海量知识与标准模板提取并解密为更便于理解和使用的形式，如果该机组与恒星际书姬网络相连，还可以同步至最新标准模板或解锁试验性项目。为确保在难以获取尖端工业品的边缘世界顺利推进殖民地基础设施建设，该标准服务器尽可能减少了高端零部件的使用，但仍然无法完全脱离星际时代工业基础。\n\n只有书姬们知道如何正确构建这座机组，而且，不知道为什么，书姬们声称该标准服务器建造所需材料里包含了一枚土豆，模板注释同样强调若缺失该材料则服务器无法运行。
LanguageData.SEC_Building_Secretary_Nexus_Client.desc:
这只是一台安装有交互界面的显示屏，只有与书姬网络服务器相连接的时候才能发挥作用，其功能取决于书姬网络服务器的子系统。在不同场合下，该客户端根据子系统类别可以满足控制生产工序、指导医疗用药、分享家庭菜谱等等多领域多层次的生产生活需要。

请注意：只有书姬们能够为这个小玩意取得书姬网络的访问授权，换句话说，只有书姬们才能建造一台正常运作的书姬网络客户端。

LanguageData.SEC_Race_Alfaus.label: Alfaus
LanguageData.SEC_Race_Alfaus.description: On a far away terrestrial planet, there is a humanoid race with rabbit ears living on a peninsula named Alfau, they are called Alfaus. The Alfaus is a humanoid race with rabbit-like features, their height, skin, organs, and skeleton are all similar to humans, but they have a pair of iconic long rabbit ears and a furry, tape-measure-like rabbit tail, in addition, their legs are quite strong, and the structure and shape of their feet are also very suitable for high-speed running and jumping. Moreover, their fertility is significantly stronger than that of ordinary humans, and their sexual impulses are more frequent and intense. This series of biological characteristics combined with the enclosed geographical environment of the Alfau Peninsula made them the most densely populated race on their home planet, and created a unique social development history, social form, and social culture, known as the Alfau Civilization.\n\nIn the early stages of the development of the Alfau Civilization, the Alfau Peninsula fell into a highly intense civil war due to its large population and limited land. Only the tribes with eased internal conflicts, reasonable resource distribution, and population growth sufficient to offset war consumption were able to survive. So under the pressure of survival, Alfaus not only invented concepts such as professional bureaucracy, planned economy, and socialized upbringing far ahead of other races, but also formed systems and cultures that curb privilege, even those tribes where only a handful of bureaucrats had the opportunity to embezzle a handful of grain were filtered out by war and famine. After the extinction of over half of the entire race, the civil war finally came to an end, and a civilization that could never escape from the 'primitive society' was born, but for people living in the future, its social form is too familiar: A 'primitive society' with a professional bureaucratic system responsible for the clan assembly, population and economic planning with rational guidance and universal social welfare and public upbringing. However, whether limited by technology and productivity levels, or by the supervisory ability of clan members, most administrative management and political and economic activities were confined to a certain region, with no interference between regions, and the entire society maintained a highly autonomous state based on clan communes.

LanguageData.SecretaryClone.label: Secretary
LanguageData.SecretaryClone.description:
On a far away terrestrial planet, there is a humanoid race with rabbit ears living on a peninsula named Alfau, they are called Alfaus. The Alfaus is a humanoid race with rabbit-like features, their height, skin, organs, and skeleton are all similar to humans, but they have a pair of iconic long rabbit ears and a furry, tape-measure-like rabbit tail, in addition, their legs are quite strong, and the structure and shape of their feet are also very suitable for high-speed running and jumping. Moreover, their fertility is significantly stronger than that of ordinary humans, and their sexual impulses are more frequent and intense. This series of biological characteristics combined with the enclosed geographical environment of the Alfau Peninsula made them the most densely populated race on their home planet, and created a unique social development history, social form, and social culture, known as the Alfau Civilization.

In the early stages of the development of the Alfau Civilization, the Alfau Peninsula fell into a highly intense civil war due to its large population and limited land. Only the tribes with eased internal conflicts, reasonable resource distribution, and population growth sufficient to offset war consumption were able to survive. So under the pressure of survival, Alfaus not only invented concepts such as professional bureaucracy, planned economy, and socialized upbringing far ahead of other races, but also formed systems and cultures that curb privilege, even those tribes where only a handful of bureaucrats had the opportunity to embezzle a handful of grain were filtered out by war and famine. After the extinction of over half of the entire race, the civil war finally came to an end, and a civilization that could never escape from the 'primitive society' was born, but for people living in the future, its social form is too familiar: A 'primitive society' with a professional bureaucratic system responsible for the clan assembly, population and economic planning with rational guidance and universal social welfare and public upbringing. However, whether limited by technology and productivity levels, or by the supervisory ability of clan members, most administrative management and political and economic activities were confined to a certain region, with no interference between regions, and the entire society maintained a highly autonomous state based on clan communes.

The secretaries were born in such a society, they are Alfaus clones created using relics from prehistoric civilization, through the combination of genetic engineering and implants, they are more agile, stronger, and smarter than ordinary Alfaus, while also having graceful bodies and full of idealism and dedication. They are able to communicate with each other in spirit, share senses, and even replace their bodies to achieve eternal life through prehistoric technologies with unknown principles. The specific process of the birth of this clone race is no longer traceable. In Alfaus' memories today, secretaries initially served as bureaucrats of worker clans living in the port cities of the Alfau Peninsula, and later took over the already limited national administrative functions. In the interstellar era, most clans still insist on managing their own internal affairs, Only regard secretaries as convenient tools for participating in national politics and communicating with other clans. Only in rimworlds, hive cities and military units do secretaries undertake more functions. But for those races without the tradition of self-management, 'let the secretaries do it' is the most common impression of secretaries, secretaries are perfect parental officials who can be relied on wholeheartedly, who can maintain a utopian life for them, far away from ambition and struggle, until the end of their life.

LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Laser_AssaultRifle.descriptio: An energy assault rifle manufactured according to standard template provided by Secretary Nexus, with bayonet.\n\nAs standard self-defense weaponry, you can see type-80 laser rifle or its varieties in every Alfaus' colonies. It's an old-school but reliable weapon, and it has been manufactured by Alfaus for at least three centuries. It is powered by standard infantry power cell and can pulse shoot 30 times, every single shot can burn through at least 20mm RHA and turn the body behind it into ashes——Human body of course. Meanwhile, an infantry power cell is only the size of an intermediate cartridge magazine with a capacity of 20 rounds, can be recharged hundreds of times without maintenance. Due to its superior tactical and logistical performance, type-80 laser rifle is widely deployed in the Alfau Militia and equipped by the riflemen in the infantry squad.

LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Thunder_Spear.label: Standard Thunder Spear
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Thunder_Spear.description: Stabbing weapon has a long history and cultural inheritance on the Alfau Peninsula, whether it's battlefield weapons or ceremonial weapons, almost every melee weapon that has left its mark in Alfau's history has the function of stabbing, even the top of the battle axes and hammers are designed with a sizable spike. So that other nations claim that Alfaus don't have axes, only halberds. Spears can be seen throughout the Alfau's history of war as representative of stabbing weapons. Until modern times, due to the development of firearms, spears were once reduced to ceremonial weapons. But with the invention and deployment of power armor, the demand for more efficient melee weapons has begun to increase, some traditional melee weapons have been redesigned, installed various devices to enhance armor penetration capabilities, and used as standard equipment in close range combat again, the spear is one of them.\n\nThunder Spear is a "thunder weapon", named after its ability to release arcs and thunder when hitting a target. The violent release of energy can penetrate and melt extremely heavy armor, causing fatal burning damage to the target.

LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Halberd.label: Alfau Classic Halberd
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Halberd.descrip: Ancient Alfaus' standard weapon, halberd occupies a place in Alfaus' history and culture with its multifunctionality and high cost-effectiveness. Its slender and sharp spearpoint can easily penetrate the fur of creatures or the armor of enemies, the curved axe blade can easily split bones and flesh, drag enemy off balance. After shortening its handle, it can also be used as a short sword or hand axe.
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Spear.label: Alfau Classic Spear
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Spear.descripti: On the Alfau Peninsula, the length of the history of spears and the history of Alfaus is almost equal. The physiological characteristics of Alfaus make this weapon extremely deadly in their hands, and its advantages in material cost and training difficulty once made Alfaus clans with large populations regard it as the only protagonist of war. Nowadays, although traditional cold weapons have been eliminated from the battlefield, spears are still preserved in the form of ceremonial weapons as a symbol of war, or sold as medieval commodities to the backward rimworld.
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Rapier.label: Alfau Classic Rapier
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Alfau_Classic_Rapier.descript: Most of the swords on the Alfau Peninsula are slender and elegant, but rarely appear in Alfau's war history. They mostly appear in people's sight as self-defense weapons or ceremonial weapons. Although not favored on the battlefield, it remains a deadly weapon in the hands of those with strong lower bodies, such as the Alfaus. The sturdy sword body designed for the Alfaus' unstoppable stabbing ensures that the fight will only last for a few rounds. This characteristic made it very popular in various low-intensity conflicts outside the battlefield, such as duels.
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Wolf_Sword.label: Wolf
LanguageData.SEC_Weapon_Wolf_Sword.description:
One of the products of the ancient worship of the wolf god, a giant sword endowed with the power of thunder. Its design is based on an ancient sword forged by the ancient Alfaus clans which was called "Wolf". In ancient times, only the strongest and most skilled champion warriors had the ability and permission to use it. Even though the traces of the last Alfau civil war have long disappeared in the long river of history, the legend of Wolf's forging has been passed down by countless clans. After the era of power armor arrived, Alfaus reforged this legendary weapon with the most advanced technology they have mastered, and awaken the thunder dormant in the giant sword during battle, turn the solid armor and the cowards hiding behind it into ashes.

The Legend of Wolf's Forging:
传说，一位未经人事的兔人少女每晚都会梦见自己与一红毛尖牙四足野兽交配，这一怪事整整持续了三个月。后有一日，少女醒来发现其小腹下沉，一夜之间忽有六月身孕，其二十四月后产下一女，其女身为极阴，头生尖耳，后生粗骨长尾，出生后短短三分便绝了哭闹索取母乳，隔天便能在床上爬行，五岁便身长40余寸，力大无穷飞檐走壁，需两头巨兔拖拽的大车其一人便可拉动。面容冷肃，却热心爱人，面容更为绝色，素有一想之美，因其母为其手织红色披风而得爱称小红帽。七岁时，一夜忽醒，连夜出门，于一渊之中寻得天外陨铁，又猎渊中一红皮大角奇兽而采其兽血，不眠不休锻打五日，得一柄大剑，名曰为狼，有诗赞之：
剑宽脊厚刃儿飞薄，杀人不见血光豪。
蓝洼洼、黄灿灿，霞光万道，瑞彩千条
小红帽16岁身长便已六十有九，终日持狼习武，不敢骤歇。一日族群外生大祸，有一苍蓝巨兽从天而降，头生鸟嘴而羽覆其身，周身遍地寒冰，目视之则恐，近其身则狂。小红帽见之，提狼便上，斗得八天八夜，终得胜，后身负巨兽下渊而去不得踪迹。
据后人所传，于某一渊之中寻得一位闭目红发尖耳少女，其背靠一蓝色巨兽，身前抱一染血铜色大剑，虽渊中尘土遍布，但少女与巨兽身上除血迹外却无半点脏污。时旅者正落难于此，为异兽追赶，不过惊鸿一瞥，不知真假不是由来，若想寻之则以为不可能之事也。
